My plot is small, only about half an acre, so I must use it well to feed my family. I want to buy fertilizer because the soil here in Balaka is tired and maize will not grow tall without it, but the price is high so I will only buy a little, maybe one bag of Urea and one of NPK if I can get the AIP coupon. I will put some goat manure from my kraal on the plot before planting, and I will plant together with pigeon peas like I always do. I cannot afford irrigation or to hire many workers — my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, and I may call a neighbor for one or two days during weeding.
